original_text:
Notice of Removal of Designated Chinese Military Company

[Docket ID: DOD-2026-OS-2410]
AGENCY:
Office of the Under Secretary of Defense (Acquisition and Sustainment), Department of Defense.
ACTION:
Notice of removal of a company from the 1260H List of Chinese military companies operating in the United States.
SUMMARY:
The Deputy Secretary of War has decided to delist the entity listed in the
SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION
section of this notice from the list of Chinese military companies operating in the United States, without prejudice to relisting the company on additional or supplementary grounds.
[Contact details omitted]
SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION:
Section 1260H of the William M. (Mac) Thornberry National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2021 (
Pub. L. 116-283
, as amended (codified at
10 U.S.C. 113
, note)) (Section 1260H) provides that the Secretary of Defense is to identify and publish a list of “Chinese military companies” annually until December 31, 2030, and to make additions or deletions to the list not less frequently than annually. Section 1260H(b)(2) requires the Secretary of Defense to publish the unclassified portion of the list in the
Federal Register
.
The Deputy Secretary of Defense has decided to delist the following entity from the list of “Chinese military companies” in accordance with section 1260H, without prejudice to relisting the entity on additional or supplementary grounds:
WuXi AppTec Co., Ltd. (WuXi AppTec)
The Deputy Secretary of War has determined that WuXi AppTec should be removed from the most recent Section 1260H List that was published in the
Federal Register
on June 10, 2026, in compliance with the order issued by the U.S. District Court of Columbia on August 7, 2026, granting WuXi AppTec's Motion for Preliminary Injunction, which enjoins the Department from enforcing, implementing, or otherwise giving effect to the Department's designation of WuXi AppTec as a Chinese military company under Section 1260H.
The entity delisted from the list of “Chinese military companies” is also identified in Mandarin and can be found in this notice's docket on
https://www.regulations.gov
.
Search by the docket ID, DOD-2026-OS-2410. The Mandarin version of the delisting notice is available for public viewing at the Supporting & Related Material tab. [Correspondence details omitted.]
Dated: November 5, 2026.
Alternate OSD Federal Register Liaison Officer, Department of Defense.
[FR Doc. 2026-22840 Filed 11-9-26; 8:45 am]
translation_ja:
米国防総省・長官室。案件番号DOD-2026-OS-2410。所管は取得・維持担当の国防次官室。

米国内で事業を行う中国軍関連企業の第1260H条リストから企業を除外する公告。国防副長官は、補足情報欄に掲げる企業の除外を決定した。追加または補足の根拠に基づき再掲載する余地がある。

改正後の2021会計年度国防権限法第1260H条は、国防長官に2030年12月31日まで毎年、中国軍関連企業を特定・公表し、少なくとも年1回追加・削除を行うことを求める。同条(b)(2)はリストの非機密部分を官報に掲載するよう求める。

国防副長官は、同条に基づき、WuXi AppTec Co., Ltd.を除外する。追加または補足の根拠があれば再掲載できる。コロンビア特別区の米連邦地裁は2026年8月7日、同社の仮差止め申立てを認め、同社を第1260H条上の中国軍関連企業とした指定の執行・実施その他の効力付与を差し止めた。同命令に従い、2026年6月10日付官報に掲載された最新リストから同社を除外する。

除外企業の中国語表記を含む公告は、規則公開サイトで案件番号DOD-2026-OS-2410を検索し、関連資料の欄で閲覧できる。

署名日2026年11月5日。国防長官室の官報連絡担当代理。官報番号2026-22840。公衆閲覧提出は11月9日午前8時45分。連絡先・個人識別情報は除外。
facts_ja: 米国防総省は、8月7日の米連邦地裁の仮差止命令を受け、WuXi AppTecを第1260H条リストから除外したと正式官報で公示。
公告は11月5日署名、11月9日公衆閲覧提出、11月10日正式掲載。追加の根拠に基づく再掲載の余地が明記されている。
